controls: encounter lifecycle state is stored with a monotonic version and timestamp
SQLite migration backfills existing records based on persisted artifacts
application compare-and-swap transitions execute in the caller's write transaction
SQLite and PostgreSQL database triggers reject illegal stage changes and version jumps
transcript persistence, note plus verification persistence, and approval persistence advance state atomically
new audio uploads and scripted demo encounters initialize recording state
transcription revisions and post-approval amendments follow explicit invalidation transitions

findings: direct demo encounter creation did not initialize lifecycle state
service catalog needed regeneration for the new module
PostgreSQL cursor wrapper lacked rowcount for compare-and-swap

ci_history.finding: PostgreSQL cursor wrapper lacked rowcount for compare-and-swap

limitations: Application integration and database migration tests use synthetic encounters; no patient data or paid service was used.
The Windows-local Starlette TestClient portal stalled during local end-to-end execution; the equivalent offline scripted workflow and PostgreSQL integration passed on GitHub Actions Linux.
Lifecycle state consistency is not clinical validation and does not authorize release or deployment.
